pages.text: Open your inventory to see your backpack above the nine hotbar slots. Each backpack slot holds one stack. Scroll to reach more slots.$(br2)The hotbar, armor, offhand, equipped Curios, and crafting grid have their own space.

pages.title: Find Items
pages.text: Click $(thing)Search$() to filter by item name or registry ID. Use $(thing)@ModName$() to filter by mod, for example $(thing)@Biomes Black$(). Click $(thing)Sort$() to group stacks by item type and close gaps across the whole backpack.

pages.title: Take and Deposit
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Left-click$() a slot to pick up or place a stack.$(li)$(thing)Right-click$() to split a stack or place one item.$(li)$(thing)Drag$() a held stack across slots to distribute it.$(li)$(thing)Press 1–9$() over a slot to swap with the matching hotbar slot.
